content.title: Burger King Brings Some Flame to U.S. Sales
content.summary: Burger King’s U.S. results are improving, and executives say they aren’t resorting to discounts like rivals to bring in Whopper fans.  The burger chain’s U.S. same-store sales increased 3.2% in its three months ended Sept. 30, accelerating from the prior quarter, and executives said Burger King is now outpacing many burger rivals and U.S. fast food as a whole.  “We've got a lot of innings to work through on Burger King, but we're very comfortable that we're seeing the results,” said Patrick Doyle, executive chairman of chain parent Restaurant Brands International.
